patch_description: The current plan fails at mode 7 due to the end-effector hanging over the edge of the banana and the feet not touching the floor. To address this, we need to ensure that the robot's feet are properly placed on the floor and that the end-effector is closer to the banana. We will add more walking steps to bring the robot closer to the banana and adjust the end-effector's approach to ensure it can make contact with the banana's surface.
